_comment: Screen definitions. Region rectangles are FRACTIONS of the frame
(x, y, w, h in 0..1) so one definition works at any resolution.
Keyword lists are matched against OCR text with punctuation/spacing stripped.
A region NAME is shared across specs on purpose: the classifier OCRs each
distinct region once per frame and pools the text, so 'top_bar' means the
STATUS: 'adventure_hub' and 'character_sympathy' are populated from real
frames on the Steam build (v2.21, 2560x1440) and are covered by
tests/test_screens.py. Add new screens with tools/probe.py + tools/tour.py.
An unlisted screen classifies as 'unknown' and HALTS the brain. That is
deliberate: guessing on an unseen screen means clicking blind.

screens.name: adventure_hub
screens.description: Main combat/adventure hub. Stage banner top-centre, hero card top-left, left icon rail (Tasks, Deals, tower timers), quest panel bottom-left, and the persistent bottom nav.

screens.name: character_sympathy
screens.description: Character detail card reached from the roster. Left nav Main/Sympathy/Skills/Destiny, right-side card with name, rarity, skill, level and PROMOTE.

screens.name: village
screens.description: Village economy screen: Income/Goal bar across the top-centre, 7 building cards each with an income value, an 'N+M' row and a gold diamond action button, quest panel bottom-left. Bottom nav is CONTEXTUAL here (Journey/Expedition replace Companions/Dungeon).

screens.name: building_panel
screens.description: Building management panel, opened by a building card's gold diamond button on the village screen. Left: worker slots and the available-worker grid with an 'ADD THE BEST WORKERS' button. Right: the building card with name, level, production and the real UPGRADE button (which shows its gold cost).
